title: Trie: Insert, Search and Prefix
summary: Store words in a trie so that words with the same beginning share the same path. Insert adds a word, search asks whether the whole word is stored, and prefix asks whether any stored word starts with the given letters.

inputs.name: ops
inputs.label: Operations
inputs.hint: Operations separated by commas: insert word, search word, or prefix word. Each word is 1 to 6 lowercase letters. Up to 8 operations (15 in standard mode).

anchors.label: Start at the root for the next word
Does the current node have a child for this letter?
search or prefix: the path ends early, so the answer is no
insert: mark the end of the word
search or prefix: count a yes
Return how many questions were answered yes
